name: Linus Pauling Distinguished Postdoctoral Fellowship
amount: Full funding for an independent research project (salary not stated)
other_rules: PhD within the last 3 years or before the start
science or engineering related to PNNL missions (energy, environment, national security), which can include biological and environmental sciences
legal right to work in the US
notes: FY27 application period opens August 2026; check PNNL careers for the deadline.
